_about: The deals tools/ads/deals.py makes ads for. half_off: half off the first month's rent on leases signed by `until`, at every building. special: one home (or two) per building at a special rent, as of `as_of`; `detail` is optional (e.g. Furnished), and a home on the website's list also gets its kind (Studio, 1-bedroom). The two deals are not combined, and every ad says so.
